title: Writing 写作
paperTitle: 2026年6月大学英语四级真题风格卷（原创题面）
prompt: Directions: Some universities now require all undergraduates to take part in research projects, while others believe the choice should be left to students. What is your opinion? Write an essay of about 150 words. You should: 1) state your position clearly; 2) support it with at least two reasons and examples; 3) suggest how such a requirement could be carried out fairly.
reference:
Should universities require every undergraduate to join a research project? In my view, a carefully organised programme is worth supporting, although the requirement itself needs some flexibility.

First, research teaches students to ask questions and test ideas, which lectures alone rarely do. A history student who spends one term checking original documents learns more about evidence than a dozen textbook chapters could offer. Second, working with a supervisor and a small team gives students a realistic taste of how knowledge is produced, and this helps them decide whether they want to continue academic study.

However, forcing students who are already struggling with heavy coursework may simply increase pressure. Universities should therefore offer short projects, clear credit rules and a list of topics to choose from.

In short, I support the requirement, provided that it is flexible and properly resourced.
